title: HVVC 13U–14U Developmental Spring Academy
description: A developmental program that introduces young athletes to club-level volleyball, building foundational skills while emphasizing consistency, confidence, and game awareness. Combines structured skill work with competitive play to prepare participants for club season expectations.

title: HVVC 10U–11U Spring Academy
description: A practice-focused developmental program introducing young athletes to club volleyball fundamentals. Emphasizes foundational skill development, team systems, positioning, and court awareness. Prepares athletes for the fall 2026–2027 club season.
notes: No game participation — scrimmages only. ~10–14 athletes.

title: HVVC 12U Spring Academy
description: A practice-focused developmental team for young athletes who have demonstrated strong interest, potential, and readiness for the next step in their volleyball journey. Serves as an introduction to club volleyball and prepares athletes for the expectations, structure, and competitive environment of club play in the upcoming fall season.

title: HVVC Summer Camp 2026
location: Adrianne Nelson High School — Main Gym
description: Join Happy Valley Volleyball Club for 4 days of high energy training, skill development, competition, and FUN led by HVVC Coaches! Whether you're newer to the game or looking to sharpen your skills before school and club season, this camp is designed to help athletes grow in a positive, competitive environment.
expect: Serving, passing, setting, attacking & defense work
High energy coaching from HVVC staff
Fun, encouraging atmosphere focused on growth & confidence

title: HVVC Pre-Season Open Gyms
description: Join Happy Valley Volleyball Club for our September Open Gyms! These sessions are intended for athletes interested in playing club volleyball with HVVC during the 2026–2027 season. Open gyms are a great opportunity for athletes to get extra touches, compete, meet our coaches, and experience the positive, high energy environment at HVVC.
expect: A preview of our 2026–2027 club season
Open to returning and brand new athletes
notes: $45 total for all 3 sessions · Questions: hvvc@hvvcvolleyballclub.com

title: 11U–14U — 2026–2027 Tryouts
description: HVVC tryouts are here! Ready to compete, grow, and be part of something special? Come try out for Happy Valley Volleyball Club for the 2026–2027 season. Come ready to work hard, compete, and show us what you've got. We can't wait to see you on the court!
